title: Bayesian prior-update synthesis output (engage-crucible Step 4)
description: Output of the mandatory Bayesian-synthesis pass. Replaces winner-picking with a posterior-update landscape, a single crucible-experiment identification, a research roadmap, and a learning objective.

rationale.description: Required when priorSource is 'uniform' (briefly justify that uniform is appropriate) or 'user-supplied' (pass through the user's rationale).

values.description: Hypothesis id → prior probability. Must sum to 1.0 ±0.01 (enforced procedurally).

posteriorLandscape.description: One entry per proposed crucial experiment. Each entry records the hypothesis-by-hypothesis posterior shift if the experiment's discriminating prediction holds.

experimentId.description: References the attacker's experiment (e.g., 'attack-for-h1'); identifies which crucial experiment this entry models.

ifPredictionHolds.description: Hypothesis id → posterior direction (qualitative ranking acceptable).

informationGain.description: Aggregate information-gain ranking across both outcome branches.

rationale.description: Why this experiment maximizes information gain per cost across the proposed crucial experiments.

crucibleExperiment.description: The single experiment with the highest information gain per cost. This is the experiment the user should run first.

conditionalOn.description: What outcome of a prior experiment makes this experiment valuable to run next.

researchRoadmap.description: Ordered sequence of experiments that resolves the most uncertainty soonest. First item is the crucible experiment.

learningObjective.description: What Bayesian intuition or research-design principle this case is teaching. Non-empty.
